title: nextPreReleaseVersion() treats identifier "0" as non-numeric and appends instead of incrementing
property: with no ids, the last numeric identifier of the pre-release is incremented by one
evidence: Javadoc: 'the current pre-release version's last numeric identifier is incremented'. "0" is a valid numeric identifier per SemVer, but private isNumeric() returns false for any id starting with "0", including "0" itself.

title: compareToIgnoreBuildMetadata orders numeric identifier above alphanumeric identifier starting with '-'
property: a numeric pre-release identifier always has lower precedence than an alphanumeric one
actual: 1.0.0-1 compares greater than 1.0.0--a (ASCII string comparison, '-' < digits)
evidence: Javadoc says the method adheres to the Specification's comparison rules; SemVer 2.0.0 item 11: 'Numeric identifiers always have lower precedence than non-numeric identifiers.' Identifiers may contain '-' ([0-9A-Za-z-]), but compareIdentifiers falls back to String.compareTo when one side is non-numeric.
